content.text:
Super common at this age, since a lot of toddlers get wary of green food around two. Skip the pressure and just put one small bite of a green on his plate next to something he already likes, and eat it yourself where he can see. It can take a lot of calm, no-pressure tries before it sticks, so a "no thanks" doesn't count as a fail.

Also, I can sign kids up for classes now if you give me the go-ahead, so say the word if you want that.
